notes.title: The most honest survival game I've ever played is this unemployment simulator
notes.notes: In real life I'm pretty sure I can't pick up a rock, grab a stick, collect some "plant fiber" (whatever the hell that is), then use those three items to craft an axe that can cut down a few dozen trees. Most likely, my "axe" would break on the first swing and I'd have better luck just punching the tree with my fist... Read more.

notes.title: Demo Out Now! Come try Unemployment Simulator 2018
notes.notes:
Here's a day to celebrate!

With the Tiny Teams Festival kicking off today, [b]the first-ever public demo of Unemployment Simulator 2018 is now available!
[/b]
Play it, leave a review, and share it with your friends if you enjoy it.

To report a bug or issue, click the "Report Bugs" button in the main menu, describe the problem in as much detail as possible, and then press Submit.

Thank you for your support!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826360/Unemployment_Simulator_2018_Demo/

notes.title: Sorry, WHAT?! 10k wishlists unlocked!
notes.notes:
[p]Can you believe that?![/p]

That's a great milestone I surely wasn't expecting to hit anytime soon, if ever.

[h3][b]10,000 wishlists![/b][/h3]

To celebrate, let me share a little secret: soon(ish), there’ll be a playable demo for everyone to try!

I can't wait to see you all start playing and hear all the feedback and thoughts you might have. 

Around the same time the demo comes out, I’ll also be able to officially update the release date on the page. That’s a big commitment (that’s why I’m waiting), but all the great reception the game has received is giving me tons of motivation to keep working hard.

So keep an eye out, more announcements are coming!

For now, back to the lab!

notes.title: US18 won a prize + publishing news!
notes.notes:
Hey unemployed friends!

Today I'm sharing a piece of news I'm still digesting, one that made me pinch my arm first and do a victory dance right after.

You remember I mentioned Unemployment Simulator 2018 got accepted into the OTK Games Expo? Well, not only did it participate, but it also won a prize!

[b]During the live streaming ceremony, US18 won the Chat Choice Award![/b]

It's amazing to realize a lot of players watched the new trailer and thought the game was worth voting for. So if you're among them and reading this: thank you!

Also, a big American streamer reacted to the trailer, which pulled in even more eyes! For reference, here’s the reaction video I’m talking about:

[previewyoutube=SSd9O4_J44o;full][/previewyoutube]

On a different note, but still pretty damn positive, I want to let everybody know that starting from yesterday I'm not completely on my own in this crazy journey they called solo developing!

Well technically I'm still developing completely on my own, but for everything else... the cavalry came!

The friendly people at turbolento games will be helping me publishing the game!

They made one pretty crazy game themselves and we seem to be on the same page about a lot of stuff. So... very excited about that!

So yeah, May has been a very productive month in terms of exposure and support, so I can now go back working my finger to the bones on the game, with a bit less doubts and new fuel.

Soon I'll have a release date in sight, and I'll share it with you too. In the meantime, spread the word about the game if you can!

Back to the lab!

notes.title: 2,000 Wishlists Celebration!
notes.notes:
Between October 2024 and March 2025, there’s been an unprecedented rise in unemployment rates—at least, according to my Steam page.

[b]2,000 of you have wishlisted the game!
[/b]
I honestly didn’t expect this kind of reception. For some, it may not be much—but for me, it’s a big deal. Especially considering the only “marketing” I’ve done is making an Instagram page and dropping a couple of posts on Reddit.

Let’s celebrate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225903/3fc4c13af6a3427ab5719c66f061ab1cc1f12b26.png[/img]

(Okay, wild celebration over. Time to regain composure.)

So, thank you for supporting me with your wishlist, and don't forget to share the trailer around if you can. We need to get this game in front of as many eyes as possible!

In the meantime, I’ll wrap up a brand new mechanic to show you soon...

notes.title: Don't mind the mess, have a seat. Welcome to the apartment!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Somewhere between a pile of dirty dishes and a dreaded trip to the supermarket, I’ve been trying to find the time to do this. Finally, I’m writing the first update in what will hopefully be a long series.

Before I get too sentimental, please note I'm leaving a portal open (a link) to my [b]brand new Discord server[/b] right at the end of this piece.

[url=https://discord.gg/j3MkFcc828][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225903/de8369ed890e94bf33dc0212f472c9b34f11eb16.jpg[/img][/url]

Now. Ever since I published the Steam page, the reception has been quite overwhelming, and way beyond my expectations as a first-time solo developer. This has been a huge confidence boost, pushing me to work harder on the project.

I’ve been especially blown away by how many people seemed to instantly get my vision for the game and found it so relatable, regardless of nationality, gender, age—you name it.
Which I suppose tells a lot about this day and age. But also affirms that comedy and art are powerful tools to highlight and explore these common human struggles we all face in our everyday lives.

Let’s celebrate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225903/76ddf4d57d79e5ab3149b835d7ef127cc83cdc64.jpg[/img]

Jokes aside, this was just to briefly update you on what’s going on (working hard on new things), let you know that I intend to share my progress here (hopefully often), and express my gratitude for the interest you've shown in the game (!).

And don't forget to join the game's Discord here: https://discord.gg/j3MkFcc828


Until the next update!

S
